entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 150 to 200 mm of rain about the main divide, and 80 to 120 mm within 20 km farther east. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected about the divide. Freezing level about 3000 m. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain, and amounts may approach warning criteria, mainly about the ranges. Note, rain spreading north during Monday afternoon and easing from the south from evening. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.
